answer_access_screen.interpretation: Flagged, short exact and near-verbatim tasks show a copyable answer and block the gate until the answer-access audit resolves them; generic short exact matches are listed without blocking it; an unflagged task is not thereby cleared.
answer_access_screen.near_verbatim_rule: a premise-context proof component (a declaration value, or an anonymous-constructor component, field value, fun body, tactic, tactic term or rewrite rule inside one) is at most max(3, n/6 rounded up) token edits (insertions, deletions, substitutions or swaps of two adjacent tokens, delimited by whitespace, brackets, commas and semicolons) from a reference proof of n tokens and at least 9 characters that is not a generic shape, changing at most 1/3 of its name components, rounded
answer_access_screen.rule: whitespace-normalized reference proof of at least 15 characters occurs in the model-visible prompt
answer_access_screen.short_exact_match_rule: whitespace-normalized reference proof of 9-14 characters occurs in the model-visible prompt and is not a generic shape (a literal reflexivity proof, one bare tactic, or a name bound by the target's binders)

interpretation: No evaluated model outcomes are inputs to this report.
Source compilation flags do not replace independent kernel and target/axiom evidence.
Hash matching establishes identity of recorded inputs, not absence of equivalent theorems or pretraining exposure.
A verification_request_hash links Lean inputs only; model-visible premise context has a separate frozen task_input_hash.
Readiness does not prove mathematical novelty, independent families, or adequate statistical power.

proposed_reference_strata.bin_rule: low <= first cut; first < middle <= second cut; high > second cut; preserve ties
proposed_reference_strata.warning: These bins measure reference source length and dependency depth, not mathematical difficulty. Incomplete coverage or tied cutpoints can leave empty cells.

scope: Dataset evidence only; model pin, budget, infrastructure and preregistration gates are separate.
